pred_texts: Instruct: Take a bowl and put 3 teaspoons of sesame oil in it.
Feedback: You are using a tablespoon to measure the sesame oil, but the recipe requires 3 teaspoons. Please switch to a teaspoon to ensure the correct amount is added.
Instruct: Now, pour in 4 teaspoons of soya sauce.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add one teaspoon of honey to it and mix the contents well.
Instruct: Now mix in half teaspoon of corn starch and mix the contents of the bowl well.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now get the firm tofu and cut it into medium sized cubes.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now take a pan and add at least two table spoons of oil to the pan to coat the surface of the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now turn on the stove. You can use medium heat.
Instruct: Now while the pan is heating up, you can coat the tofu cubes with mixture of oil, soy, honey and corn starch. Start with a few cubes.
Instruct: You can now add the cubes coated with the mixture one by one to the pan to fry. Make sure that the pan is hot. The cubes should start to sizzle once you add them.
Instruct: As there is space left in the pan, you can coat more cubes evenly with the mixture and then fry them to the hot pan.
Instruct: Now use a spatula to turn the tofu so that they are evenly fried.
Instruct: Now keep on frying and turning the tofu to make sure that the tofu is cooked until golden and crispy.
Instruct: Once the tofu is golden and crispy to your taste, you can remove the tofu pieces into a pan or a pot.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: You can repeat this process by putting more tofu cubes into the mixture and then frying them until they are golden and crispy.
Instruct: You can remove the fried tofu pieces them from the pan.
Instruct: You can add the remaining tofu pieces coated with the mixture to the pan for frying.
Instruct: Now keep turning the tofu pieces to that they are fried evenly until they are golden and crispy.
Instruct: Now you can remove the tofu and put them in the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: You can now turn off the stove.
Success: Step complete.
